comment: The message shown to shoppers when reCAPTCHA validation rejects their submission.
modal: The text displayed on storefront forms when the reCAPTCHA check fails and the submission is treated as a bot. Can differ per website or store view, so the wording can be localised per store.

comment: The message shown when reCAPTCHA cannot be verified due to a technical error.
modal: The text displayed on storefront forms when reCAPTCHA verification cannot complete for a technical reason (for example the service is unreachable), rather than because the shopper failed the check. Can differ per website or store view.
